resolution.note: test resolves node_modules from require.resolve('zod'); 3/3 pass in a lane worktree without node_modules

title: agents-render test resolves node_modules the way Node does, so it passes in a lane worktree
body:
Why: lane fix-close-rule (#833): test/agents-render.test.ts symlinks ../node_modules relative to the test file; in a krn lane worktree (.krn/worktrees/<slug>) there is no node_modules at that root (Node resolves upward), so the copied script fails on missing zod.
Outcome: the test links the node_modules directory Node actually resolves (e.g. dirname of the zod package path) so it passes in the main checkout and in any lane worktree.
Proof: the test passes when run from a fresh krn lane worktree without its own node_modules.
